text: After COPY to Trash, the parser saves the destination UID set from COPYUID. The deletion path parses it, builds compact UID ranges, selects Trash and marks/expunges those destination UIDs before reselecting the original mailbox. Preserve the mailbox ownership of each UID set; source message identifiers cannot be substituted for destination UIDs. No COPYUID malformed/missing response test or server execution was included in this landing. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Use the COPYUID destination set in the Trash mailbox
